description: Editable page layout recipes used by neuctra-ui-page-builder. Add a layout object with a unique id, aliases, keywords, outline, componentQueries, designRuleNumbers, seoRuleIds, and responsiveNotes to extend the catalog.

layouts.name: Online Tool Page
layouts.purpose: Help visitors understand, use, and trust one focused online tool.
outline: Single H1 naming the tool and outcome
Short direct explanation and trust notes
Primary tool workspace with clear inputs and output
How-to steps and supported formats or limits
Visible FAQs with matching FAQ schema
seoNotes: Use SoftwareApplication/Product schema only when accurate; include visible steps as HowTo data when useful.
Keep the page explanation, H1, metadata, and tool behavior aligned.
If the tool is client-only, prerender the page frame, text, FAQs, and JSON-LD.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Keep the tool task prominent on mobile, stack controls and results in task order, and avoid horizontal overflow.

layouts.name: Blog Article Page
layouts.purpose: Make an article easy to scan, understand, cite, and continue reading.
outline: Table of contents for long articles
Readable article sections with ordered headings
Examples, lists, or comparisons where useful
Visible FAQs when they answer real follow-up questions
seoNotes: Use BlogPosting only for a genuine article and provide real author and date details.
Answer the primary query near the start; use descriptive question headings for relevant subsections.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Use a readable text measure, a collapsible or compact table of contents, and ensure code or tables remain usable on small screens.

layouts.name: Application Dashboard
layouts.purpose: Help signed-in users monitor key information and complete frequent actions.
outline: Responsive application shell and primary navigation
Page title, context, and one primary action
Main chart, table, or activity view
Loading, empty, error, and success states
seoNotes: Private dashboards should normally be noindex and require authentication; do not expose private data in public structured data or sitemaps.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Prioritize the main task and key metrics; adapt navigation, charts, and tables for narrow screens without hiding essential status.

layouts.name: Marketing Landing Page
layouts.purpose: Explain the product value and guide visitors toward one clear conversion action.
outline: Hero with specific value proposition and primary CTA
Trust evidence or testimonials when real
Pricing or plan details when relevant
seoNotes: Keep page claims and any Product/SoftwareApplication schema factual and visible.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Keep the value proposition and CTA visible early on mobile, vary section layouts, and avoid oversized decorative content.

layouts.name: Form Workflow Page
layouts.purpose: Let users enter information with clear instructions, validation, and recovery from errors.
outline: Form purpose and expected completion time
Inline help and clear required/optional labels
Review or confirmation step for complex forms
seoNotes: Index public informational form pages when useful; noindex private submission or account flows.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Use full-width controls on small screens, preserve entered values after validation errors, and keep labels and errors readable.

layouts.name: Authentication Page
layouts.purpose: Help users securely sign in, create an account, or recover access with minimal distraction.
seoNotes: Authentication and recovery routes are usually noindex and excluded from the sitemap.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Keep the form usable with one hand, preserve accessible focus and errors, and avoid forcing horizontal scrolling.

layouts.name: Settings Page
layouts.purpose: Let users find related preferences and understand which changes are saved.
outline: Settings navigation grouped by mental model
Clear save/apply behavior and unsaved state
seoNotes: Signed-in settings should require authentication, be noindex, and stay out of public sitemaps.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Convert side navigation to a compact selector or stacked navigation and keep save actions reachable.

layouts.name: Data Listing Page
layouts.purpose: Help users scan, search, filter, and act on a collection of records.
outline: Page heading, record count, and primary action
Sortable data table or suitable list
Empty, loading, error, and no-results states
seoNotes: Index curated public directories when they provide unique value; noindex private, thin, or arbitrary filtered result URLs.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Prioritize columns and actions; use a responsive list/card pattern or controlled horizontal scrolling for genuinely tabular data.

layouts.name: E-commerce Page
layouts.purpose: Help customers understand an item, trust the offer, and complete the next purchase step.
outline: Product title, images, price, and availability
seoNotes: Use Product and Offer structured data only for visible, current product information and real prices.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Place product choice, price, availability, and purchase action in a clear mobile order; keep galleries touch friendly.

layouts.name: Documentation Page
layouts.purpose: Help readers locate accurate information and follow examples without losing their place.
outline: Clear page title and concise summary
Table of contents for long pages
FAQs where they answer common questions
seoNotes: Use TechArticle only when the content is genuinely an article; otherwise describe the page with an appropriate WebPage type.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Keep navigation discoverable, code readable, and the article measure comfortable across breakpoints.

layouts.name: Custom Page Layout
layouts.purpose: Select a structure from the request rather than forcing it into an unrelated template.
componentQueries: components that fit the requested interaction and content
seoNotes: Apply only SEO elements relevant to a public, indexable page and the content it actually contains.
layouts.responsiveNotes: Preserve task order and readability at narrow widths; adapt controls to touch and keyboard use.
